text:
debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r r-u-n-n-e-d s-c-r-i-p-t-s t-o a-u-t-o-m-a-t-e l-o-g-i-n b-y-p-a-s-s e-x-p-l-o-i-t-s a-g-a-i-n-s-t t-h-e l-o-y-a-l-t-y a-c-c-o-u-n-t s-y-s-t-e-m and l-e-f-t b-e-h-i-n-d a c-r-e-d-e-n-t-i-a-l s-p-r-a-y l-o-g while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-c-c-e-s-s l-e-v-e-l r-e-v-i-e-w
2) the a-c-t-o-r i-n-j-e-c-t-e-d s-c-r-i-p-t-s t-o d-r-a-i-n g-i-f-t-c-a-r-d b-a-l-a-n-c-e-s and l-e-f-t b-e-h-i-n-d a f-r-a-u-d-u-l-e-n-t t-r-a-n-s-a-c-t-i-o-n h-i-s-t-o-r-y while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the f-r-a-u-d a-n-a-l-y-s-i-s c-h-e-c-k
3) the a-c-t-o-r c-h-a-n-g-e-d p-a-s-s-w-o-r-d-s t-o t-a-k-e o-v-e-r a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s and l-e-f-t b-e-h-i-n-d a c-o-n-t-r-o-l l-i-s-t of c-o-m-p-r-o-m-i-s-e-d a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the o-w-n-e-r-s-h-i-p v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n s-t-e-p
4) the a-c-t-o-r c-o-n-v-e-r-t-e-d b-a-l-a-n-c-e-s t-o c-a-s-h and g-o-o-d-s t-h-r-o-u-g-h f-a-k-e o-r-d-e-r-s and l-e-f-t b-e-h-i-n-d a l-i-s-t of o-r-d-e-r i-d-s and p-a-y-m-e-n-t m-e-t-h-o-d-s while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the t-r-a-n-s-a-c-t-i-o-n v-a-l-i-d-a-t-i-o-n p-r-o-c-e-s-s
5) the a-c-t-o-r u-s-e-d b-o-t n-e-t-w-o-r-k-s t-o m-i-m-i-c n-o-r-m-a-l s-h-o-p-p-i-n-g b-e-h-a-v-i-o-r and l-e-f-t b-e-h-i-n-d a l-o-g of i-p a-d-d-r-e-s-s-e-s and a-c-t-i-v-i-t-y p-a-t-t-e-r-n-s while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the b-e-h-a-v-i-o-r a-n-a-l-y-s-i-s c-h-e-c-k
